title: Add workflow catalog view
verified: Workflow catalog renders grouped service, package, content, update, support and ecosystem workflows.
Workflow detail shows input schema, risk, approval requirements, rollback expectation and evidence outputs.
Catalog exposes local-only and optional external dependency status while baseline remains local-only.
Workflow launch points are preview commands and do not create PlanSpec or run snapshots.
Catalog is projection-only and does not suggest direct execution.
risk_notes: Workflow Catalog consumes CapabilityIndexProjection and does not own planner, resolver or side-effect authority.
Launch preview is typed-command-only and remains separate from PlanSpec creation.
Host-changing workflows display rollback and exact approval requirements.
External dependencies are explicitly optional for baseline operation.
